projects.name: AnchorPQ
projects.description: AnchorPQ is an Android Post-Quantum Integrity Framework that verifies application authenticity using deterministic bytecode fingerprinting with Merkle Trees and runtime verification. The framework uses ML-KEM (CRYSTALS-Kyber) for post-quantum secure communication between Android clients and a Quarkus-based verification server.

channels.description: Support ongoing development and maintenance of AnchorPQ.
